ops.title: Cadence review: include a late cadence request in Jev input
ops.description:
Owner: j6563-cadence change owner.
Evidence at HEAD c86d7e9ba5c544b31b1961eab0e6ee1fda56d4a6: settled.py:1151 searches all words, but settled.py:1155 supplies only words[:BODY_CHARS], with BODY_CHARS=1500 at settled.py:29. A long order ending in 'Give me updates every 15 mins' can find 15 locally while Jev never sees the request and answers no, silently leaving every unset.
Next step: construct bounded Jev context that includes the matched request and enough surrounding words, retaining one yes/no question. Add a long-order regression. Review was static; no tests were run.

ops.text: A request after character 1500 is included in the single cadence Jev request and sets the requested minutes on the correct order.
A late interval referring only to a tool schedule sets no update cadence.
